title: The end cards share one flat shell
why: The critic scored the Extracted, KIA, Abandoned and haul cards 2 of 5: HUD showing through, a glowing glass card, small buttons, amber lines. One flat 720px panel, blurred scrim, 56px buttons, rarity bars. Restyle only.
now: The end cards are cleaner: flat panel, bigger buttons, the world blurred behind.
